subject.title: Scripts: Organize 150+ files in scripts/ directory by function with README index

question: Should OpenClaw keep the flat `scripts/` layout with the new README index, or sponsor a broader scripts taxonomy and path migration?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow bug fix; it changes maintainer-facing automation paths that are referenced across scripts, package commands, docs, and workflows.

options.title: Keep flat layout plus index
options.body: Treat the merged README as the sufficient low-risk improvement and close this issue if maintainers do not want script path churn.

options.title: Approve a staged taxonomy migration
options.body: Define categories, update all references, and decide whether compatibility wrappers or aliases are needed before moving files.

options.title: Split narrower docs follow-ups
options.body: Track any missing index detail separately while leaving existing script paths stable.

recommendation.title: Keep flat layout plus index
recommendation.body: Treat the merged README as the sufficient low-risk improvement and close this issue if maintainers do not want script path churn.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is path compatibility and maintainer workflow policy, where the current file-history signal is strongest.
